fields.Name: T142 - Archive Run Detail Drawer
fields.Description: Exercises the run-viewer's click-to-open slide-in detail drawer (OpenRunDrawer → async loadRunDetails for per-record rows, CloseDrawer) — a custom drawer + secondary async fetch, distinct from any grid row-open or the config editor.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "Run History renders summary metric cards and a run card list (or a clear 'No archive runs found' empty state)",
    "Clicking a run card opens a slide-in 'Run Details' drawer with the run summary, an Archived/Failed/Skipped stats row, and a Per-Record Results section",
    "The drawer closes when its X button or the backdrop is clicked",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
